looks.label: Role-coded radar blips
looks.technique: One image per role (standard, corpse, waypoint arrow, structure, group, ring, target bracket, entrance). Blip width comes from the pixel-to-world ratio with a role-specific floor and ceiling; bracket and ring add a fixed pad so overlays stay centred

looks.label: Timed group loot claim window
looks.technique: Three buttons (none, selection, all); draining timer bar from remaining time fraction; automatic send of the current selection on timeout; closes on send or when the container is gone. Defect from reading: no one-shot guard, so a duplicate send is possible on the frame before close (not run). Fix: a sent flag checked before send
